title: What if the reason you're struggling…
paragraphs:
What if the reason you're struggling…
is because you forgot who you are in Christ?

Scripture:
“I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.”
— Galatians 2:20

Caption:
Your old identity died with Christ.

The shame.
The guilt.
The version of you defined by your past.
It was nailed to the cross.

You are not the person you used to be.
You are a new life walking in grace.

You are redeemed.
You are chosen.
You are His.
If this speaks to you today…
